name: Stirge

actions.name: Blood Drain
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage, and the stirge attaches to the target. While attached, the stirge doesn't attack; instead, at the start of each of its turns it deals 5 (1d4 + 3) Necrotic damage to the target and regains hit points equal to the damage dealt. A creature, including the target, can take an action to detach the stirge, which then has to land on the ground or fly away.

description: Stirges are winged, bloodsucking parasites that drift on the wind until they catch the scent of a warm-blooded creature, then dive to latch on and gorge.
